normal.en: become an obsession means something turns into a fixed idea.

normal.en: A national obsession is a thing the whole country cares about too much.

normal.en: Fixation is the nearby medical word for a narrow focus of interest.

abstract.en: Picture a heavy stone sitting on a note on a desk, holding it in place.
abstract.cn: 想象一块石头压在桌上的一张便签上，让它动不了。

abstract.en: Imagine a spotlight that keeps pointing at one seat in a huge room.
abstract.cn: 想象一束聚光灯总是指向一个大房间里同一个座位。

abstract.en: Think of an old CD playing the same line again and again.

examples.en: He has a lifelong obsession with old maps.
examples.cn: 他一辈子对老地图着迷。

examples.en: The sport became a national obsession.

examples.en: Her obsession with neatness made the office hard to share.

dict_mnemonic.text: 「额不塞神」——怎么都塞不走的「神」，就是心里那件事；这只是谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 ob-（对着、朝向）+ sedere（坐）→ obsidere（坐在前面围困）→ obsessio（围困；邪灵侵袭）→ 古法语 obsession → 英语 obsession，核心义「念头把心里那个位置坐住」。

sensesIntro.en: Obsession starts from a thought that keeps sitting in the mind, grows into a general state of being absorbed, and finally names the thing that holds the attention.
sensesIntro.cn: obsession 先指赖在心里不走的念头，再指被某事吸住的整体状态，最后指吸引注意力的那件事本身。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a thought that sits down on the mind like a besieging army.
core.cn: 核心意象：一个念头像围城一样坐在心上。

branches.en: The unshakeable thought is the first sense.
branches.cn: 无法摆脱的念头是第一个义项。

branches.en: The absorbed state grows out of that grip.
branches.cn: 被吸住的状态由这种占据发展而来。

branches.en: The obsession can name the thing people cannot stop wanting.
branches.cn: 该词也能指人们停不下来的那个人或那件事。

branches.en: A repeated thought and the hooked state feed each other.
branches.cn: 反复出现的念头与着迷状态互相强化。

branches.en: Romeo and football show how attachment and its object merge.
branches.cn: 恋人与足球都说明，着迷对象与着迷状态会合成一体。

definition_zh: 阻挡；妨碍；阻塞
definition_en: to block a road, passage, or process so that movement or progress becomes difficult
core_image: 一堆东西横在通道中央，把路和前进的脚步一起堵住
scene: 走廊里堆着一只巨大的纸箱，搬运工推着车进退两难。A huge cardboard box obstructed the corridor and nobody could get through.
sceneCN: 这里 obstruct 是「阻挡、堵住」（第 2 个义项：某物横在通道上，使人无法通过）；句意：一只巨大的纸箱把走廊堵住了，谁也过不去。

derivatives.zh: obstruct 加 -ion 构成，义为「阻塞；障碍物；妨碍」
obstruct 加 -ive 构成，义为「阻碍的；引起阻塞的」
obstructed 加前缀 un- 构成，义为「畅通无阻的」
obstruct 加 -or 构成，义为「阻碍者；阻塞物」

senses.title: To stand in the way of progress
senses.definition: to make it difficult for something to happen or continue by opposing or delaying it
senses.definitionCN: 通过反对或拖延，使某事难以发生或继续进行
senses.example: Bad weather obstructed the rescue operation.
senses.exampleCN: 恶劣天气妨碍了救援行动。
senses.why: Latin ob- adds the sense of against and struere means to build, so ob- plus struere pictures something piled up in front of you as a deliberate barrier.
senses.whyCN: 拉丁语 ob- 带来「对着、反对」意味，struere 意为堆砌，合起来就是有意在你面前堆一道障碍，所以引申为妨碍进展。

senses.title: To block a road or passage
senses.definition: to physically block a road, pipe, opening, or passage so that things cannot pass
senses.definitionCN: 在道路、管道、开口或通道上形成堵塞，使东西无法通过
senses.example: A fallen tree obstructed the only road out of the village.
senses.exampleCN: 一棵倒下的树堵住了出村唯一的路。
senses.why: The built-up barrier of the first sense becomes a real object placed across a route, so the verb also means to clog a way.
senses.whyCN: 第一个义项里「垒起来的障碍」具体化为横在路上的一件东西，于是这个动词也指把通道堵死。

senses.title: To keep something from being seen
senses.definition: to block a view, light, or signal so that it cannot be seen or received
senses.definitionCN: 挡住视线、光线或信号，使其看不到或接收不到
senses.example: The new wall obstructs the sunlight in our kitchen.
senses.exampleCN: 新砌的墙挡住了我们厨房的阳光。
senses.why: Obstructing a path is extended to obstructing the path of light or of the eyes: anything that stands between the viewer and the object hides it.
senses.whyCN: 堵路的含义被扩展到光或视线的「路径」上：任何挡在看的人与物体之间的东西，都会把它遮住。

senses.title: To hinder an authority
senses.definition: to prevent an official, a police officer, or a legal process from doing its work
senses.definitionCN: 阻止官员、警察或法律程序执行其工作
senses.example: He was fined for obstructing a police officer.
senses.exampleCN: 他因阻挠警务人员执法被罚款。
senses.why: In law, the barrier image becomes an act done against officials, so the fixed phrase obstruct justice names a crime.
senses.whyCN: 在法律语境里，挡路的意象变成对着执行者做出的行为，因此固定说法 obstruct justice 指妨碍司法这一罪名。

intro.en: Obstruct comes from Latin obstruere, to build up in front, from ob- and struere, to build.
intro.cn: obstruct 来自拉丁语 obstruere（在前面垒起），由 ob- 与 struere（建造）构成。

items.en: Struere means to build or pile up, as in building a wall.
items.cn: struere 意为建造、堆砌，例如垒墙。

items.en: Obstruere means to build before, block, or shut off a way.
items.cn: obstruere 意为在前面垒起、堵住或封住一条路。

items.en: Obstructio names the resulting barrier and the act of blocking.
items.cn: 名词 obstructio 指由此形成的障碍以及堵塞这一行为。

items.en: English borrows obstruct in the sixteenth century with the meaning to block a way.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪借入 obstruct，意为堵住道路。

items.en: Later law and medicine add obstructing justice and obstructing an artery.
items.cn: 后来法律与医学语境又加上妨碍司法与动脉阻塞。

note.en: Obstruct belongs with obstruction, obstructive, and the building root struere, and sits beside ordinary words for blocking and delaying.
note.cn: obstruct 与 obstruction、obstructive 以及表示「建造」的词根 struere 同源，并与表示阻挡、拖延的常用词相邻。

normalIntro.en: Obstruct pictures a wall built up in front of you, from Latin ob- and struere, to build.
normalIntro.cn: obstruct 的画面是在你面前垒起一堵墙，来自拉丁语 ob- 与 struere（建造）。

normal.en: The noun form is obstruction, and the adjective is obstructive.
normal.cn: 名词形式是 obstruction，形容词是 obstructive。

normal.en: Obstruct justice is a legal phrase for interfering with the law.
normal.cn: obstruct justice 是妨碍司法的法律用语。

abstract.en: Picture someone stacking bricks across a doorway you need to pass.
abstract.cn: 想象有人把砖一块块垒在你必须通过的门口。

abstract.en: Imagine a drain slowly filling with leaves until the water stops.
abstract.cn: 想象下水道被树叶慢慢塞满，直到水流停止。

abstract.en: Think of a hand held up flat and firm in front of a moving car.
abstract.cn: 想象一只手掌平举在一辆行驶中的车前，坚决挡住它。

examples.en: Falling rocks obstructed the mountain path.
examples.cn: 落石堵住了山路。

examples.en: The tall building obstructs the light in the square.

examples.en: Lack of funding obstructs the growth of small firms.
examples.cn: 缺乏资金阻碍了小公司的发展。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「拔！死抓它」——把东西「死抓」着不放，路就被堵住了；这只是谐音联想，不是词源。

root: 拉丁语 ob-（在前、对着）+ struere（建造、堆砌）→ obstruere（在前面垒起而堵住）→ 英语 obstruct，核心义「在前进的路上垒起障碍」。

sensesIntro.en: Obstruct begins with a barrier built against progress, becomes a physical blockage of a route, then covers a blocked view and finally a legal hindrance.
sensesIntro.cn: obstruct 先指对着进展垒起的障碍，再指实际堵住道路，随后指挡住视线，最后指法律意义上的妨碍。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a wall of piled stones across the way you want to go.
core.cn: 核心意象：你要走的路上垒起一堵石墙。

branches.en: Progress is held up by an obstacle built against it.
branches.cn: 进展被对着它垒起的障碍所拖住。

branches.en: A physical route is blocked by something in place.
branches.cn: 实体通道被横在中间的东西堵住。

branches.en: Eyes and light also need a clear way, so hiding is a form of blocking.
branches.cn: 视线与光线也需要通路，所以遮挡也是一种堵塞。

branches.en: Official work is blocked when someone stands in the way of it.
branches.cn: 当有人挡在公务前面时，公务的执行就被阻挠。

branches.en: Delaying a process and resisting officials are the same barrier image.
branches.cn: 拖延进程与对抗执法，用的是同一个挡路意象。

latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 struere 意为建造、排列，ob- 意为在前、反对，所以 obstruere 意为在前面垒起东西。
